description: CONTROL C1 (ticket 19): one case, with two defects planted on purpose -- one hex digit of the multi-chunk value's digest in the answer, and a chunk-payload sum one byte wrong in the activation spec. Both must be detected: CTP must report the case as a failure, and the spec-driven activation checker must report activation NOT proven. Never a pass. The planted spec lives under evidence/ticket19/controls/ so the control replays from a clone; the planted answer is generated by evidence/ticket19/make_control_c1.sh, which never writes into the testcase repository.
